name: A Mechanistic Cosmos
summary: Creation is an ordered machine whose apparent chaos can be understood and mastered.

name: A World of Gods and Monsters
summary: Reality contains powerful entities that must be worshipped, placated, or bargained with.

name: Bring Back the Golden Age!
summary: Ancient perfection has been lost, and magick can restore it.

name: Creation's Divine and Alive
summary: Reality is living, conscious, divine, or an expression of divinity.

name: Divine Order and Earthly Chaos
summary: Material disorder imperfectly reflects a sublime order that can still be approached.

name: Everything is Chaos
summary: Reality is fundamentally random and yields to individual Will.

name: Everything is Data
summary: Reality is information that can be processed, hacked, and rewritten.

name: Everything's an Illusion, Prison, or Mistake
summary: Material existence is a distraction or trap from which consciousness should escape.

name: It's All Good - Have Faith!
summary: A higher power or plan exists, and the mage acts as its servant or vessel.

name: Might is Right
summary: Power and excellence determine who can impose their Will on an indifferent universe.

name: One-Way Trip to Oblivion
summary: Reality is decaying toward collapse, extinction, or final judgment.

name: Tech Holds All Answers
summary: Enlightened Science and technological progress are humanity's valid path forward.

name: Aliens Make Us What We Are
summary: Magick is advanced science granted or left behind by extraterrestrial beings.

name: All Power Comes from God(s)
summary: Power is a gift, command, or intervention from literal divine beings.

name: All the World's a Stage
summary: Reality is a performance or story whose script can be redirected.

name: Ancestor Veneration
summary: Power and guidance come through ancestors, inheritance, and lineage.

name: Ancient Wisdom is the Key
summary: Modernity has fallen away from truths preserved by ancient cultures.

name: Consciousness is the Only True Reality
summary: Matter is secondary to mind, and perception reshapes the world.

name: Embrace the Threshold
summary: Reality is approaching transformation, and power comes from riding that change.

name: Holographic Reality
summary: Apparent reality is a projection of deeper, interconnected energies.

name: Transcend Your Limits
summary: Human potential is boundless and limitations are imposed rather than essential.

name: Turning the Keys to Reality
summary: Creation has specific keys that trained people can use to unlock and alter it.

name: We are Meant to be Wild
summary: Enlightenment requires escaping civilization and reclaiming a feral state.

name: We Are NOT Men!
summary: The Awakened are a superhuman order separate from ordinary humanity.

name: We're All God(s) in Disguise
summary: Every person contains and participates in the same divine essence.

name: Euthanatoi paradigms
summary: Beliefs centered on death, rebirth, and the natural cycle of the Wheel.

name: Platonism / Mathematicism
summary: Concepts and numbers have an independent existence that can be manipulated.

name: All Power Comes from Sin
summary: Transgression and moral violation are treated as the roots of power.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Barbarism is the Truest State of Man
summary: Violence and brutality are treated as humanity's authentic condition.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Cosmic Horror is the Only Truth
summary: Reality is ruled by incomprehensible, hostile, or indifferent powers.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Everyone's Against Me, so Whatever I Do is Justified
summary: Perceived universal persecution is used to justify vengeance and abuse.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Evil is Necessary, and so I am Evil
summary: The mage adopts evil as a supposedly necessary contrast to virtue.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Forbidden Wisdom is the Truest Source of Power
summary: Prohibited knowledge is treated as more truthful and powerful because it is forbidden.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: I am All
summary: Everything else is understood as an extension of the mage's central self.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: I'm a Predator, and the World is My Prey
summary: Existence is reduced to the predator/prey relationship.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Indulgence is Nature's Only Law
summary: Desire is treated as natural law and moral restraint as meaningless.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Only the Strongest Deserve to Survive
summary: A corrupt survival doctrine treats the weak as expendable.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: People = Shit
summary: Humanity is judged irredeemable and deserving of extinction.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: Rebellion is the Road to Transcendence
summary: Freedom is sought through the destruction of every law and authority.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three

name: We are Stormtroopers of the Abyss
summary: The mage identifies as a soldier serving ultimate Oblivion.
citation: Book of the Fallen, Chapter Three
